dex.entry: An ancient moss-lord of the Hollow whose entire body is a cathedral of bioluminescent growth; it breathes out a spore-fog that coats opponents' scales and slows their movement, while healing allies who stand within its light. A creature that IS a living forest shrine — kids who love Verdant AND Ligh
